kind: budget endpoint checkpoint/run identity correction; CPU software results only
user_context: multi-node acceleration and existing checkpoint reuse clarification
hypothesis: Every cost-selected budget endpoint must be evaluated from its actual run/checkpoint identity, including extension runs and pre-switch trajectory endpoints.
cause: The earlier coordinator, following published cluster.budget_eval_tasks, paired a policy row matched-horizon run_id with budget_endpoint_update. The actual selected endpoint can have a different run_id, so eval_tasks silently returned no checkpoint.
fix: Capture the canonical SeedBank.budget_endpoint selector result while policy_rows executes; schedule its actual run_id/update/hash. Missing or changed selected checkpoint fails explicitly. Published paper source is untouched.
controls: Same frozen trainer and source runtime
Same actual V8 ToyBackend seeds5/6/7 with prefix25,H75,safety100
Same frozen cost-only budget selection; no reward-based endpoint changes
Old coordinator blob with strengthened new integration assertion fails on missing selected checkpoint; fixed coordinator passes

metrics.tasks: Unique dispatched task identity, not scientific result count
metrics.budget_coverage: Each canonical selected endpoint run_id/update maps to the evaluated checkpoint SHA256
metrics.duplicates: Multiple execution records per task identity
metrics.reward: Training-batch logs and final held-out evaluations remain separate; CPU ToyBackend values are software data

integration.scope: CPU multi-process software integration; not scientific RLVR results
